Lane A · Client & policy data
initClient→initClientDetails→getPolicyDetails→initAgentDetails
Searching on the Requests dashboard (0) calls initClient against Triglav; opening a client's Portfolio (1) pulls their master data, policies, funds and the agent's own record — all live from AdInsure3.

Lane B · AI fund allocation ★ the flagship
getClientData→findWeightsNew ★
Reaching Funds selection (3) writes the request to ClientData, then findWeightsNew reads all three stores and returns the allocation with its Slovenian rationale — the Risk band (2) caps what it may propose. Inside it: Agent 1 · investment consultant → allocation JSON · Python weight-normalizer · Agent 2 · Slovenian rationale.

Lane C · Document generation
createDocuments→createPdf→FileDownloader
Advancing past Signature city (6) collects the request into createDocuments, Triglav renders the contract PDFs, and the document plugin uploads them — ready for the signing session on the next screen.

Lane D · Digital signature
signingJob→create user · login ticket · upload docs→getSignDocuments
Document sign (7) opens a BetrSign session — creates the signing user and job, uploads the generated PDFs, fetches a login ticket — while getSignDocuments polls Triglav until every signature is in.

Lane E · Request lifecycle
insertInstanceForAutoClose→updateRequestInstance→AutoCloseRules→CloseRequests
A request enters the tracker when the Portfolio (1) opens, and its status updates at Signature city (6) and the Final summary (8); the timer then sweeps the tracker and closes any request that was started but never finished.
